posts.title: Wednesday Comics: DC, February 1986 (week 3)

posts.title: A List of 16th Century German Nicknames & Criminal Monikers
posts.description: I've mentioned The Faithful Executioner and the record kept by Nuremberg's executioner, Franz Schmidt, in a previous post. What I didn't mention was in Schmidt's accounting of the criminals he punished, he often gives their aliases. I thought they were pretty interesting and inspirational for rpgs.
